# Kitchener Heating & Cooling

> Kitchener Heating & Cooling provides heating and cooling service to homeowners in and around Kitchener, Waterloo Region, Ontario. The team handles furnace and AC repair, ductless mini-split installation, heat pump service, gas fireplace work, thermostat upgrades, and duct cleaning.

Phone: (548) 457-1029  |  Email: contact@kitchenerheatingcooling.ca  |  Website: https://kitchenerheatingcooling.ca

Service areas: Kitchener, Cambridge, Waterloo, Elmira, Listowel, New Hamburg, Baden, Breslau
